turns.contentExcerpt: Exploration 1: The homepage’s “Unavailable” freshness state conflates valid but old data with missing data. A useful next tweak is to distinguish **“Needs update”** (valid but older than 24 hours) from **“Unavailable”** (network or parse failure), ideally with the last update’s age. This would make the existing status genuinely informative without adding dependencies; I’ll confirm the smallest HTML/CSS/JS shape in exploration 2.
